icons.name: Falkenkreis
icons.motiv: A golden falcon of Horus emblem seen from above, circling in a tight spiral with wings spread wide, surrounded by a ring of swirling blue-white wind.
icons.hinweis: The falcon is drawn in the Egyptian manner: head in profile with the dark Horus eye markings and a hooked beak, wing feathers in stylized layered bands inlaid with lapis lazuli and gold.

icons.name: Sturz des Falken
icons.motiv: A golden falcon of Horus emblem diving steeply head-down with talons thrust forward, streaks of motion trailing behind it.
icons.hinweis: The falcon is drawn in the Egyptian manner: head in profile with the dark Horus eye markings and a hooked beak, layered stylized wing feathers inlaid with lapis lazuli.

icons.name: Eid der Maat
icons.motiv: The white ostrich feather of Maat glowing with golden light, floating above a raised open palm, sparkling gold motes.
icons.tex: dark stone with faint engraved hieroglyphs
icons.hinweis: The feather is the tall plumed ostrich feather of Maat, its quill inlaid with gold.

icons.name: Blick des Udjat
icons.motiv: The Eye of Horus (udjat) forged from blackened iron and hammered gold with a luminous turquoise iris, a shockwave ring of light pulsing outward.
icons.hinweis: The eye is the classic Eye of Horus with its curled tail line and brow, in profile.

icons.name: Strahl des Re
icons.motiv: A blazing red-gold sun disc of Re with a rearing cobra, a straight beam of white-gold light shooting downward and ending in small glowing hands.
icons.tex: dark painted plaster with faint stars
icons.hinweis: The sun disc of Re is encircled by a rearing uraeus cobra, the rays end in small human hands in the manner of the Aten.

icons.name: Fäuste des Month
icons.motiv: Two clenched fists wrapped in linen bandages and bronze studs striking rapidly, with several ghost afterimages and ochre impact sparks.
icons.hinweis: The fists wear bronze wrist guards engraved with Egyptian patterns and the falcon-head emblem of the war god Month.

icons.name: Schritt des Schu
icons.motiv: A bare sandaled foot mid-stride dissolving into streaks of swirling wind and white feathers, a small star where it lands.
icons.hinweis: The sandal is a woven papyrus sandal with a lotus-flower toe strap.

icons.name: Kreis des Ka
icons.motiv: The Egyptian ka symbol, two raised arms, inside a glowing turquoise ring of light with a red beating heart at its center, healing sparks rising.
icons.tex: dark stone with faint concentric carved circles
icons.hinweis: The two arms are drawn exactly like the hieroglyph ka, upstretched with flat hands.

icons.name: Gebs Lachen
icons.motiv: A mighty stone fist smashing into cracked earth that splits open with glowing green fissures, flying rock shards, Geb the earth god.
icons.hinweis: The fist and the split earth are carved like a stone relief of the earth god Geb, with green hieroglyphs glowing in the cracks.

icons.name: Atem des Schu
icons.motiv: A billowing sail catching a powerful wind, curling turquoise and white breath streams, flying feathers.
icons.hinweis: The sail is a square linen Nile-boat sail with a painted wadjet eye, the wind drawn as stylized wavy lines.

icons.name: Neiths Fächer
icons.motiv: Five golden-tipped arrows with red fletching fanned out from a single point over the crossed-arrows-and-shield emblem of Neith, glowing carnelian light.
icons.hinweis: The emblem of Neith is two crossed arrows over a small round shield, drawn as in temple reliefs.

icons.name: Sprung der Gazelle
icons.motiv: A golden gazelle emblem in a graceful mid-leap with a curl of dust and wind trailing beneath it, a faint red glow.
icons.hinweis: The gazelle is drawn in the flowing Egyptian relief manner with long curved horns and slender legs.

icons.name: Upuauts Hatz
icons.motiv: The snarling head of Wepwawet's desert fox, ears pricked forward, with golden slash marks and a red glow in its eyes.
icons.hinweis: The head is drawn in profile like the jackal-like Wepwawet, with tall pointed ears and a gold collar.

icons.name: Sieben Pfeile der Sachmet
icons.motiv: Seven arrows falling from above in a tight volley onto a glowing carnelian circle, a lioness-goddess sun disc glowing behind them.
icons.hinweis: The sun disc of Sekhmet carries a rearing uraeus; the arrows are slender with reed shafts and flint tips.

icons.name: Pfeil der Neith
icons.motiv: A single long golden arrow piercing straight through three glowing scarab beetles in a row, trailing a red streak.
icons.hinweis: The scarabs are sacred Egyptian scarabs with segmented shell patterns.

icons.name: Zorn des Seth
icons.motiv: The head of the Seth animal with a forked violet lightning bolt arcing from it to two small clay jars, storm-red glow.
icons.hinweis: The Seth animal is drawn faithfully: long downward-curved snout and tall, square-tipped upright ears.

icons.name: Schritt durch die Duat
icons.motiv: A five-pointed golden star inside a circle, the Duat sign, framed by a swirling violet portal ring, a faint ghostly figure dissolving into its center.

icons.name: Seschats Maß
icons.motiv: The palm-rib measuring staff of Seschat topped with a seven-petal star, wrapped by a faint violet ring of slowed time, grains of sand hanging in the air.
icons.hinweis: The staff is the notched palm rib of Seshat, topped by her emblem of a star with a bow-shaped crown.

icons.name: Hu, das Machtwort
icons.motiv: An open speaking mouth sending out concentric violet shock rings of golden light, the spoken word of the god Hu.

icons.name: Fallender Stern der Nut
icons.motiv: A blazing golden star with a fiery tail falling from the star-covered arched body of the sky goddess Nut.
icons.tex: dark plaster painted with faint stars
icons.hinweis: Nut is drawn as an elongated arched figure whose body is covered in stars, as in temple ceiling paintings.

icons.name: Rotbier der Sachmet
icons.motiv: An ochre clay beer jar with red beer foaming over its rim, a small lion-goddess stamp on the clay, warm golden light.
icons.hinweis: The jar is a tall, tapered Egyptian beer jar with a pointed base and painted bands.

icons.name: Starker Ka
icons.motiv: The ka sign, two upraised arms, with an ankh between them, in hammered gold with a steady warm glow.

icons.name: Auge des Horus
icons.motiv: A sharp Eye of Horus in hammered gold and blackened iron with a bright pupil and small star glints.

icons.name: Flügel des Ba
icons.motiv: A ba-bird, the human-headed soul bird, in swift flight with trailing feather streaks.
icons.hinweis: The ba is drawn in the Egyptian manner: a falcon body with a small human head in profile wearing a wig.

icons.name: Fülle des Hapi
icons.motiv: Nile flood waves with a blooming lotus and overflowing water, turquoise and gold.

icons.name: Hand des Month
icons.motiv: A fist gripping a curved khopesh sword of hammered bronze and gold.
icons.hinweis: The khopesh is the sickle-shaped Egyptian sword.

icons.name: Speer des Seth
icons.motiv: A spear piercing a coiled serpent, the prow of Seth's barque behind it.

icons.name: Wahr an Stimme
icons.motiv: A golden scale of Maat balancing a human heart against the white feather, lapis blue glow.

icons.name: Hauch des Schu
icons.motiv: A single large ostrich feather in swirling turquoise breath.

icons.name: Upuauts Rudel
icons.motiv: A jackal standard on a pole with a fox pup standing beside it, carnelian red glow.
icons.hinweis: The standard is the Egyptian Wepwawet standard: a jackal figure on a pole with a flat base.

icons.name: Wort des Thot
icons.motiv: An ibis of Thoth holding a scribe's palette and reed pen, violet glow.
icons.hinweis: Thoth is drawn as a sacred ibis with a long curved beak, in profile.

icons.name: Wucht
icons.motiv: A small glowing ochre flame-star, simple and bold, a leaf-sized badge emblem.

icons.name: Eile
icons.motiv: A small turquoise winged sandal, simple and bold, a leaf-sized badge emblem.

icons.name: Ast Klinge
icons.motiv: A khopesh blade of hammered bronze, a simple bold emblem, lapis blue glow.

icons.name: Ast Licht
icons.motiv: A golden sun disc with straight rays, a simple bold emblem, lapis blue glow.

icons.name: Ast Eid
icons.motiv: The feather of Maat, a simple bold emblem, lapis blue glow.

icons.name: Ast Faust
icons.motiv: A clenched fist wrapped in linen, a simple bold emblem, turquoise glow.

icons.name: Ast Atem
icons.motiv: A billowing sail in the wind, a simple bold emblem, turquoise glow.

icons.name: Ast Ka
icons.motiv: The two upraised arms of the ka sign, a simple bold emblem, turquoise glow.

icons.name: Ast Fächer
icons.motiv: A fan of five arrows, a simple bold emblem, carnelian red glow.

icons.name: Ast Neith
icons.motiv: Two crossed arrows over a small shield, a simple bold emblem, carnelian red glow.

icons.name: Ast Sachmet
icons.motiv: The head of a lioness, a simple bold emblem, carnelian red glow.

icons.name: Ast Gewitter
icons.motiv: A forked lightning bolt, a simple bold emblem, violet glow.

icons.name: Ast Sterne
icons.motiv: A five-pointed star in a ring, a simple bold emblem, violet glow.

icons.name: Ast Wort
icons.motiv: An open speaking mouth, a simple bold emblem, violet glow.
